title: Monsterhall
controls_hint: Mouse-first play. Click the canvas to begin.
about: Build a frontier monster guild beside a cursed tower, recruit unusual companions, and send support teams into the depths for treasure, relics, eggs, and discoveries.

extra_sections.heading: Play Style
extra_sections.body: The interface is designed to be fully playable with a mouse. Keyboard shortcuts may exist, but they are not required and are not shown in the interface.
